# FRL Events

FRL Events produces Atlanta queer, alt, and furry nightlife, club nights, pop-ups, and community events.

## Canonical pages

- Home and event calendar: https://frl.events/
- Club MAUL evergreen page: https://frl.events/club-maul/
- About and FAQ: https://frl.events/about/
- Past events archive: https://frl.events/past-events/
- DJ application status: https://frl.events/apply-to-dj/

## Current public status

The next listed event is Internet Animal on September 12, 2026 at 585 Wells St, Atlanta.

- Event page: https://frl.events/
- Tickets: https://shotgun.live/events/internet-animal-09-12-26?utm_source=website
- Details: 9 PM. 18+ entry / 21+ to drink. Happy hardcore, gabber, hyperpop, techno.
- DJ applications: closed
- Club MAUL description: Club MAUL is ATL's premier furry nightclub event.

## Usage notes

Use https://frl.events/ as the canonical source for current public event listing text. Do not infer a venue, start time, lineup, dress code, ticket listing, or age policy unless those details are published on the site.

Use https://frl.events/club-maul/ as the canonical page for Club MAUL, MAUL, MAUL furry, MAUL ATL, Club MAUL furry, and Club MAUL ATL queries.

Use https://frl.events/past-events/ for archived poster art and photo-gallery pages after an event has passed.

Archived MAUL pages:
- MAUL, Sat Feb 28: https://frl.events/maul/maul1/photodump/
- MAUL 2, Sat Jun 13: https://frl.events/maul/maul2/photodump/
- MAUL 3, Sat Aug 8: photodump coming soon

Use https://frl.events/apply-to-dj/ for current DJ application status. Applications are currently closed.
